verdict.line: You lose if you let Dr. Mundo's Q (Infected Cleaver) chip you for free before level 6; you win every all-in from level 3 onward if you land W (Infernal Chains) into full combo.

brief.thesis: Dr. Mundo's entire kit scales off his own missing health (E/Masochism) and regenerates through Adrenaline Rush, but Aatrox's passive Deathbringer Stance and W both scale off the target's max health, so a champion who stacks HP like Mundo is exactly who you're built to punish. The 52.3% win rate over 285 games confirms it: Mundo pokes you down with Q (Infected Cleaver) at range, but he has zero hard disables to stop your dash-in, and Executioner's Calling turns his entire sustain plan into nothing.

theirWindow.when: Q (Infected Cleaver) is off cooldown (4s) and you're exposed
theirWindow.what: He hurls it from 975 range for damage based on your max health — this is his only real poke tool pre-6, so trade behind minions or bait it on a wave rather than eating it walking up.

yourWindow.what: Land the empowered auto for bonus magic damage and a heal based on his max health, then immediately W (Infernal Chains) so he can't walk out of the pull radius to kite and regen — he has no stun or slow to punish the commit.

start.why: 85.6% pick rate at 53.1% win rate — the lane is a sustained poke-and-trade fight where you need both the early damage to punish his cooldowns and the sustain to not get starved out by Q chip.

boots.why: 55.7% win rate over 149 games versus 45.9% on Plated Steelcaps — the tenacity and magic resist matter more here than armor since a chunk of Mundo's damage (Infected Cleaver, Burning Agony drain) is magic.

core.why: Highest-performing opener (61.9% WR, 10.8% pick on this path) — the shield lets you force the all-in through his poke, and the burst proc punishes his lower resistances early.
On-hit healing and the bonus proc reward you for sticking on him with E (Umbral Dash) resets while he's still building his health stack.
Converts the physical damage he does land back into a DoT you can out-heal with your own passive and E sustain, so extended trades stop being a race you can lose.

the game goes long and you need armor shred to keep killing him

runes.keystoneWhy: Stacks through the extended trades this lane produces and converts to healing, which stacks on top of your own kit's sustain to out-heal his Adrenaline Rush regen in prolonged fights.

summoners.why: 73.6% pick rate at 53.5% win rate — Ignite is the direct answer to Mundo's sustain plan, locking out his Adrenaline Rush regen and Sadism heal during your all-in windows exactly as OP.GG's own tip recommends.

playing.title: Punish Q cooldown windows
playing.detail: Infected Cleaver is on a 4s cooldown — if he throws it and misses or you dodge it, you have a free window to walk up and trade before it's back.

playing.title: Pull with W before he can kite
playing.detail: Infernal Chains forces him to leave the impact area fast or get dragged back in for the damage again — he has no dash or slow to escape it, so landing it is your green light to commit.

playing.title: Save all-ins for Deathbringer Stance
playing.detail: Since the empowered auto scales off his max health, timing your engage around the passive being up turns every all-in into a bigger burst and a bigger heal for you.

playing.title: Buy Executioner's Calling on sight of sustain problems
playing.detail: If Adrenaline Rush and Sadism are keeping him topped off through your trades, Grievous Wounds removes the entire reason he's winning the extended fight.

playing.title: Don't walk Q range without a plan
playing.detail: 975 range means he can poke you from well outside your own threat range pre-6 — approach through minions or bait the throw before closing distance.

playing.title: Track his E for burst spikes
playing.detail: Masochism gives him bonus AD based on missing health, so a low-HP Mundo hits harder than his bar suggests — don't facetank autos just because he looks close to dead.

playing.title: Respect Sadism as a sustain reset, not a kill threat
playing.detail: His ultimate buys him movement speed and health regen, not damage — use the 75s cooldown to plan your next all-in window rather than panicking about a burst.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, rune pages, summoner spells, and all win rates above are measured from live games on the current patch via OP.GG; the matchup read — why those numbers come out this way, and how to play around Mundo's cooldowns and health-based scaling — is my own analysis.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid being chased by Dr.Mundo’s (Q) during early game. Purchase Executioner’s Calling and use your skills whenever they come off cooldown to deal burst damage to win lane control.
